findings.claim: Skift (2026-05)：連鎖飯店推動直訂約十年後，OTA 市占大致維持原樣，直訂通路未出現結構性轉移。
findings.source: Skift《Direct Booking Tug-of-War: Hotels' Long Bid to Take Back Power》
findings.excerpt: Ten years after Hilton, Marriott, and other chains began coaxing travelers to book directly, online travel agencies still control roughly the same slice of the pie.

findings.claim: Hilton 10-K：Hilton Honors 會員 2.43 億，會員經 Hilton 偏好通路訂房可享即時優惠（付款滑桿、會員折扣、免費 Wi-Fi），為直訂導向的忠誠度機制。
findings.excerpt: Hilton Honors members who book through preferred Hilton channels also have access to instant benefits, including a flexible payment slider that allows members to choose nearly any combination of points and money to book a stay, an exclusive member discount and free standard Wi-Fi.

findings.claim: Skift：Hilton B2B 重組以與 Navan 直連為核心，Hilton for Business 企業註冊數超過 40 萬。
